scientific.integrity: The motivating full text was inspected at the model, disease-free elliptic problem, variational reproduction number, principal-eigenvalue equivalence, endemic-equilibrium theorem, equal-diffusion global-attractivity theorem including the equality case, and large-diffusion discussion. The exact threshold is derived directly from these equations and checked by standalone exact arithmetic. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific.limitations: The threshold is for the equal-diffusion ray d_S=d_I. It is an exact variational characterization and generally not an elementary closed form. The dynamical conclusion is global attractivity at the level proved by the motivating source; no new critical decay rate is asserted.

title: Exact common-mobility threshold for a hostile-boundary SIS model
